liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Called scorching; Phil later said in an interview he had a spiritual experience during the segue jam; Reviewer felt it lacked the expected bounce and seemed to be going through the motions [6][13][15]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Reviewer's pick if you only download one song from this show; Jerry opened with many sour notes, then recovered and played well for the rest of the show [8][11]
- **Easy Answers** (2 reviews): Reviewer considers it a weak song, possibly among the worst the band played; Easy Answers into Don't Ease Me In ended the first set flatly after a strong start [5][6]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reportedly the first Chicago Dark Star with lyrics in twenty years; the 6-22-91 version was instrumental; Jerry's use of MIDI was the highlight, and the band interplay was memorable [11][15]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Reviewer found it lackluster, as if going through the motions, lacking lazy wandering [13]
- **High Time** (1 review): Singled out as a standout moment of the show [5]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Described as beautiful in the second set [6]
- **Standing On The Moon** (1 review): Considered one of the best versions of the song [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-03-16.139174.sbd.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Static from Bobby's guitar is audible in New Minglewood Blues and So Many Roads [1]
- **gd1994-03-16.sbd.3D.567.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 163 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: FM-like interference on a soundboard input channel runs from about six minutes into Minglewood until 8:40; The interference came through the PA, so it also appears on audience tapes, and on So Many Roads [2]
- **gd94-03-16.sbd.ladner.7778.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 152 min; rated 3.58/5 by 24 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer sat just in front of the soundboard and says the recording matches what they heard there; Poor acoustics at Rosemont Horizon hurt the sound at this show; Attendee noticed a nasal vocal sound in this spring 1994 run, similar to the Ohio 94 recording [5][10][12]
- **gd1994-03-16.140065.fob-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- John Cutler's first show as the band's soundman [11]
- Veteran security staff up front stopped working and watched the band in awe [14]
- Reviewer sat high up on Jerry's side with a good view down on the front row [14]
- Reviewer sat front row dead center, seats 27 and 28, with tickets bought by mail order [15]
- Front-row viewer recalls Bobby's spit flying through the on-stage lighting [16]
- Reviewer says the band had declined by 1994-95, but this is a solid show from the final years [8]
- Reviewer ranks it among the highlights of 1994 [10]
- Reviewer compares the nasal vocals here with those heard on an Ohio 94 show [12]
- Reviewer calls it a highlight of 1994 [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-03-16.139174.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Dat Master (Panasonic SV-3700/44.1k) [1]
- **gd1994-03-16.sbd.3D.567.shnf**: transferred by 3d; source: SBD->DAT->Computer->CD->SHN [2]. Also: Digital transfer from a DA-P1 via a Digital Audio Labs card; set one downsampled from 48kHz to 44.1kHz in Cool Edit Pro [2]
- **gd94-03-16.sbd.ladner.7778.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Dat> Sonic Solutions> CDR> WAV> SHNv3 [4]
- **gd1994-03-16.140065.fob-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44 Source Info:FOB Schoeps MK4-> Reutelhuber P/S-> DATTransfer Info:Dat (Panasonic SV-3700) -> Marantz CDR-615 -> CD (Late 90's)Extract Wav-> Flac Level… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Rosemont Horizon - March 16, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/march-16-1994) [18]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-03-16 Rosemont Horizon, Rosemont, IL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-03-16-rosemont-horizon-rosemont-il-usa/) [19]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Rosemont Horizon - March 16, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/march-16-1994) [20]
